messages:
Marta: quick async check on the Optimize toolkit delivery — I want to lock owners and near-term milestones for the quantization recommendations + batching/caching docs. two urgent asks: 1) who owns the final signoff for the quant profiles, 2) are we blocked on infra for the new prefix cache change?

Alex: for signoff i can own the quant profiles (will coordinate with research). timeline: aim to finalize profiles by EOD Wed. i need a run of the regression evals on latest model-quant branch first.

Sasha: infra-wise, prefix cache change needs a tiny infra flag rollout (vpc-safe). eng-infra already provisioned the feature flip but we need a small network test. not blocked, but needs someone to kick the can on testing.

Marta: @Alex & @Sasha — can you two pair on the test? if infra tests pass we can merge and start canary. who volunteers to write the canary policy?

Alex: i can draft a simple canary: 1% traffic, 10m ramp, rollback on latency + output divergence > 2%. will post PR with policy snippet.

Jia: quick FYI — ci-bot shows the last PR failed the unit tests in optimizer core (flaky kv-cache test). tagging @Kevin since you opened that refactor.

Kevin: saw that, reproducing locally. looks like a race in kv eviction when batching spikes. putting up a fix this morning — PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/optimize-toolkit/pull/432

ci-bot: test report: optimize-toolkit PR #431 -> status: failed; failing suites: kv-cache-test (x2 flaky), quant-eval-suite (1 failed case). logs: https://ci.redwood/optimize/431/logs

Sasha: thanks @Kevin. once your fix lands can we rerun the regression evals? Alex, can you queue the evals or should i?

Alex: i'll queue them once Kevin's PR merges. note to team: the eval harness needs to run both sample-based quality checks and the new perf bench to catch tail latency regressions.

Marta: ownership summary for clarity: Alex -> quant profile signoff + evals, Sasha -> infra test & canary rollout config, Kevin -> kv-cache fix + follow-up tests, Jia -> monitor regressions and alert on quality drops. i'll own coordinating release notes and the rollout window.

Jia: putting a lightweight regression alert rule in the monitoring dashboard now. if quality metric drops > 1.5% we get a pager. putting it behind a noisy threshold for now. :rotating_light:

Kevin: merged the kv fix -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/optimize-toolkit/pull/432 (merged). tests running on CI.

ci-bot: test report: PR #432 -> status: passed; kv-cache-test fixed.

Alex: queued regression evals at 09:05 UTC. will report results here.

(12m later) Alex: evals done: sample-quality delta: +0.2% (good), tail latency p95: +30ms (within canary threshold), p99: +120ms (approaching threshold). Suggest canary at 0.5% traffic first, monitor p99 for 30m, then ramp to 5% if stable.

Sasha: i can create the canary policy and schedule the rollout for tomorrow 14:00 UTC to hit low-traffic window. adding fallback model variant in policy.

Marta: perfect. action items: Alex finalize quant docs and attach profiles -> due Tue; Sasha create canary policy + run infra test -> due tomorrow 10:00; Kevin follow up on any kv edgecases -> ongoing; Jia configure regression alerts + verify dashboards -> today EOD. i'll update the tracker and send a short note to product.

Kevin: quick note — saw one edge case where large batch sizes (>=128) push kv eviction more frequently. i'll add a regression test for that.

Marta: thanks all. ping me if you need support on rollout approvals. :thumbsup:
